purpose: Canonical toolchain and repo entrypoints for the Lombard hard-mode reconstruction. Reuse these components; do not invent parallel pipelines unless a documented gap requires it.

required_source_classes: San Francisco city GIS / street centerline / ROW
San Francisco elevation contours / survey-derived vertical controls
street-level imagery metadata from Google Street View / Mapillary / KartaView where available
acquisition.rule: Add Lombard-specific acquisition scripts under pipeline/acquire/. Raw licensed imagery stays ignored/private.

georeference.rule: All source coordinates must be transformed through the locked project CRS/frame before Minecraft geometry is generated.

terrain.rule: Terrain truth comes from reconciled LiDAR/DEM/city elevation evidence; previews and profiles precede export.
terrain.promotion_gate: Original observations only; explicit missingness and support limits; residual gate; scan-order invariance; source comparison before local geometry correction.

roads.rule: Switchbacks, curbs, sidewalks, stairs, terraces, retaining walls, and planters must derive from verified source geometry.

astra_microblocks.rule: Use for sub-meter fidelity where vanilla geometry is too coarse; validate exact block-entity and microcell readback.

required: exact Astra block-entity/microcell readback when used

banned_shortcuts: whole-site detailed generation before slice review
using screenshots as coordinate truth when structured geometry exists
copying Redfield-specific architectural assumptions into Lombard
milestone_authorization: 2026-10-02: user requested work on all five realism findings and a new Redfield full block; evidence limits remain explicit.
